data.title: Digital School OS
data.description: A digital education platform designed to manage learning, courses, students, progress and educational workflows.
data.problem: Learning centres juggle courses, students and progress across disconnected tools.
data.solution: One platform where courses, student progress and workflows live together, with AI assistance layered on top.
data.outcome: A single workspace for managing learning end to end.

data.title: AI Bosh Buxgalter
data.description: An AI-powered accounting assistant concept designed to automate accounting workflows and business financial operations.
data.problem: Routine accounting work is repetitive and slow for small businesses.
data.solution: An assistant that handles questions and routine bookkeeping steps through a chat interface backed by structured financial data.
data.outcome: A concept showing how accounting workflows can be automated with AI.

data.title: OffPay
data.description: A business payment and invoice management platform.
data.problem: Businesses need one clear place to track invoices and payments.
data.solution: An admin platform with a dashboard for payments, invoices and reporting.
data.outcome: A SaaS-style admin panel for day-to-day payment operations.
